question: Can a user inspect saved work progress without selecting or combining ranking criteria, while preserving verified original evidence and the existing ranking/export interfaces?
controls: Writer and reader progress agree on empty, partial and complete runs; zero negatives, failures, unpublished staged evidence and repeated attempts retain distinct counts
Progress is detached, has no ranking criterion/native payload and fails on closed connections
Mixed-criterion legacy progress counts work without ranking; existing explicit ranking disagreement remains refused
Fresh guarded CLI --summary matches API progress, preserves database bytes and imports no scientific or attribution namespace
Summary/export mutual exclusion and summary/ranking-option conflicts fail before database I/O; old ranked and export commands remain compatible
Missing, corrupt, implicitly admitted legacy and corrupt unpublished evidence cannot produce successful progress
Existing saved-reader/export/CLI regression bodies, affected distribution contracts, full Ruff, reporting, archive and index checks

Same exact owned installed wheel passes the selected reader/export/CLI controls outside the checkout with published support payloads and documented summary commands on original complete/partial/legacy saved databases

resources.aggregate_limits: No own systemd user runtime was available at the preceding checkpoint. Recheck availability; enforce and record per-process OS limits without accessing another user's bus.

publication: Own control/code text and scalar/hash receipts only; original native/query/database bodies and third-party payloads remain local
nonclaims: No new science, public-library connector, molecular collection, benchmark, biological validation, full dependency solve, full supported platform qualification or release
